messages.alchemist.client-flows.previous-executio: The previous execution lease is still active. Check again after it expires.
messages.alchemist.client-flows.select-passage-do: Select a passage in the document, then open annotations.

messages.alchemist.client-flows.task-cannot-conti: This task cannot continue. Return to its original content.
messages.alchemist.client-flows.title: Title
messages.alchemist.client-flows.what-do-want-expl: What do you want to explore?
messages.alchemist.client-views.both-reports-cove: Both reports cover this version. Choose a next step based on the evidence and unknowns.
messages.alchemist.client-views.collection-empty-: This collection is empty. Start with a direction or collect market signals.
messages.alchemist.client-views.confirm-scope-mod: Confirm scope, model, and call budget before starting.

messages.alchemist.client-views.only-part-researc: Only part of the research fit within the budget. Complete the research before deciding.
messages.alchemist.client-views.previous-report-r: The previous report remains below. This run has no new conclusion yet.
messages.alchemist.client-views.refining-failed-d: Refining failed. Your direction is saved. Check the model and retry.
messages.alchemist.client-views.research-did-not-: Research did not finish. Collected material is kept. Confirm a new plan to retry.
messages.alchemist.client-views.research-running-: Research is running. You can leave and return later.
messages.alchemist.client-views.results-entry-isn: The results entry isn’t connected yet; you can reuse research methods for now.
messages.alchemist.client-views.select-text-repor: Select text in a report, annotate it, and turn the feedback into a research method.
messages.alchemist.client-views.task-paused-revie: This task is paused. Review its continuation conditions before running it.
messages.alchemist.client-views.these-guide-prefe: These guide your preferences; they are not market evidence.
messages.alchemist.client-views.too-much-material: Too much material. Remove material or shorten the task and retry.
messages.alchemist.client.item-no-longer-exists-w: This item no longer exists or was deleted
messages.alchemist.client.no-model-available-conn: No model is available. Connect a model and try again. Nothing you have here is lost.
messages.alchemist.ui.check-whether-selected-item: Check whether the selected items apply
messages.alchemist.ui.choose-results-methods-reus: Choose the results and methods to reuse this time. Earlier conclusions serve as background; this research still checks new evidence.
messages.alchemist.ui.collecting-contacts-toolify: Collecting contacts Toolify, Watcha (观猹) and GitHub and only reads public pages; none of your content is sent. GitHub uses only the account you pick in Source settings; without one it searches anonymously, with a lower rate limit.
messages.alchemist.ui.discussion-annotations-item: Discussion and annotations for this item
messages.alchemist.ui.every-project-shares-choice: Every project shares this choice. The GitHub source uses only the account picked here, and its token stays in the host; without one it searches anonymously, with a lower rate limit. Accounts are managed in Settings › Service connections.
messages.alchemist.ui.example-reuse-interview-que: For example: reuse the interview questions; recheck pricing and competitor changes.
messages.alchemist.ui.no-confirmed-method-applies: No confirmed method applies this time. You can annotate the research report, then confirm and save.
messages.alchemist.ui.no-earlier-results-read-yet: No earlier results to read yet. After a research run, you can save a fixed version.
messages.alchemist.ui.not-filled-check-before-ado: Not filled in; check before adopting
messages.alchemist.ui.only-40-most-recent-readabl: Only the 40 most recent readable results are shown; keep looking with a fixed-version reference.
messages.alchemist.ui.pick-up-where-left-off: Pick up where you left off
messages.alchemist.ui.results-entry-isn-t-connect: The results entry isn’t connected yet; you can reuse research methods for now.
messages.alchemist.ui.why-results-reused-what-sti: Why the results are reused, and what still needs rechecking
messages.alchemist.work-reuse-client.chosen-not-s: Chosen is not the same as used. Cross-checking hasn’t finished this time, so there is no record of what was actually adopted.
messages.alchemist.work-reuse-client.examples-whe: Examples where it applies (one per line)
Examples where it doesn’t apply (one per line)
messages.alchemist.work-reuse-client.how-should-f: How should future research or judgment change?
messages.alchemist.work-reuse-client.not-adopted-: Not adopted yet. You can retry, or choose manually and continue.
messages.alchemist.work-reuse-client.only-plan-sa: Only the plan is saved so far. Once research starts, the versions actually used are recorded separately.
messages.alchemist.work-reuse-client.research-use: The research used these items, but their source links still need to be written. Retrying adds only the links; it doesn’t call the model again.
messages.alchemist.work-reuse-client.run-s-actual: This run’s actual record is saved.
messages.alchemist.work-reuse-client.saving-creat: Saving creates a new version; versions already used stay as they were.
messages.alchemist.work-reuse-client.some-sources: Some sources can’t be read right now, so related content is hidden; the records of what was used and where it came from are kept.
messages.alchemist.work-reuse-client.suggestion-h: The suggestion hasn’t been adopted. Keep the choices that apply, then confirm the research plan.
messages.alchemist.work-reuse-client.what-had-re-: What you had to re-explain this time
messages.alchemist.work-reuse-client.what-still-n: What still needed preparing this time
